inputs.description: EEG localizer and retrieval signals, stimulus categories, trial memory labels and respiration timing/phase. Respiration and remembered status are analysis stratifiers; saved classifier outputs are validation artifacts.

preprocessing.description: Author scripts remove mastoid/respiration channels, rereference, downsample, standardize and apply temporal/PCA operations differently across localizer and decision-value branches. The repository uses train-only PCA/ridge LDA and a coarser grid; native equivalence and final-paper/source differences must be resolved.

metric.description: Source classification metric is ROC AUC for object/scene discrimination (Figure 1c and Figure 3a code). Remembered-minus-not-remembered contrasts and significance are separate inferential results, not an optimization score.

aggregation.description: The source keeps participant×training-time×retrieval-time arrays (and a searchlight branch) then performs participant-level contrasts. A faithful, predeclared scalar or simultaneous comparison over the original time/channel support and its numeric author result are not recovered.

full_panel.description: The original scoped task requires the complete exhalation-aligned object/scene AUC panel (Figure 3a), peak-reactivation respiration/memory association with nonremembered and all-trial companions (Figure 3b and supplementary plots), and alpha/beta–reactivation coupling (Figure 3c), including participant memory, independent-localizer and source-required cue/power controls. Native training/test-time matrices, spatial searchlight support, phase/decision trajectories, channel/time power-coupling arrays and inferential outputs cannot be replaced by a scalar average. The three declared Figure 3b coefficients are an incomplete scalar subset, not the full panel. Final-article source mapping, exact structured panel/axes and required companion roster remain unresolved; other whole-paper branches are not automatically added to the retained central scope.

Preserve missingness, every trial identity and the remembered/nonremembered/all companion table; no pooled-trial correlation.
